p4_b6.ocr: Onset and speed of efficacy A single short-term study to determine the onset and also the speed of efficacy of the collars against R. sangui- neus and I. ricinus was conducted. In this study collars were fitted to the treated group of dogs on Day 0 and directly thereafter all the dogs were infested with R. san- guineus and I. ricinus. Ticks were removed and counted 48 h later on Day 2. On the same day the dogs were re- infested with R. sanguineus and I. ricinus and efficacy determined 6 h later.
